levelBasis: Parola curriculum placement; references establish meanings and forms, not CEFR certification.

senses.ex: Il divano è in soggiorno.
senses.exEn: The sofa is in the living room.
senses.note: A room in a home. This lesson does not teach a period spent away from home.

senses.ex: Il nostro soggiorno a Torino dura tre giorni.
senses.exEn: Our stay in Turin lasts three days.
senses.note: A period spent in a place; here it is a trip, not a room.

senses.ex: Ho messo le chiavi nella borsa.
senses.exEn: I put the keys in the bag.
senses.note: A bag used to carry things.

senses.ex: La società è quotata in Borsa.
senses.exEn: The company is listed on the stock exchange.
senses.note: A financial market. Borsa is often capitalised in this meaning.

senses.ex: Il mio capo arriva alle nove.
senses.exEn: My boss arrives at nine.
senses.note: This lesson models il capo. For a woman, la capo also occurs; la capa is mainly colloquial or jocular in Italy. Formal contexts generally use the specific office title, such as la direttrice. Clothing uses a separate meaning.

senses.ex: Ho comprato due capi di abbigliamento.
senses.exEn: I bought two items of clothing.
senses.note: A countable garment, often in capo di abbigliamento.

senses.ex: Ha chinato il capo per salutare.
senses.exEn: They bowed their head in greeting.
senses.note: The body-part meaning, often more formal than testa. Its plural is capi.

senses.ex: L’Italia è un paese europeo.
senses.exEn: Italy is a European country.
senses.note: A country or state, not a small settlement.

senses.ex: Abito in un piccolo paese di montagna.
senses.exEn: I live in a small mountain village.
senses.note: A small inhabited settlement. Country uses the same spelling.

senses.ex: Sono stato a Roma due volte.
senses.exEn: I have been to Rome twice.
senses.note: A count of occasions: una volta, due volte.

senses.ex: La cappella ha una volta affrescata.
senses.exEn: The chapel has a frescoed vaulted ceiling.
senses.note: A curved architectural covering; this is not an occasion.

senses.ex: Ho la gola secca.
senses.exEn: My throat is dry.
senses.note: A body part. Mal di gola means a sore throat.

senses.ex: Il fiume scorre in una gola profonda.
senses.exEn: The river flows through a deep gorge.
senses.note: A narrow deep valley with steep sides.

senses.ex: Chiudi la tenda della finestra.
senses.exEn: Close the window curtain.
senses.note: A screen of fabric used in a room.

senses.ex: Montiamo la tenda al campeggio.
senses.exEn: We put up the tent at the campsite.
senses.note: A portable shelter used for camping.

senses.ex: In casa il riscaldamento è acceso.
senses.exEn: The heating is on in the house.
senses.note: Usually singular for heating or a heating system in a home.

senses.ex: Prima della gara facciamo il riscaldamento.
senses.exEn: We warm up before the competition.
senses.note: Exercises before sport; distinct warm-ups can be counted.

senses.ex: Non posso uscire: ho già un impegno.
senses.exEn: I cannot go out: I already have a commitment.
senses.note: An obligation or arranged engagement.

senses.ex: Studia con molto impegno.
senses.exEn: They study with great dedication.
senses.note: Usually singular for the effort devoted to an activity.

senses.ex: Mio nonno è in pensione.
senses.exEn: My grandfather is retired.
senses.note: A pension is a benefit; in pensione means retired. No particular retirement age or entitlement is asserted.

senses.ex: Dormiamo in una pensione vicino al mare.
senses.exEn: We are staying in a guesthouse near the sea.
senses.note: An establishment providing accommodation, often with meals.

senses.ex: Abbiamo scelto la mezza pensione.
senses.exEn: We chose half board.
senses.note: A lodging meal arrangement, especially mezza pensione and pensione completa; normally singular in these phrases.

senses.ex: La storia è la mia materia preferita.
senses.exEn: History is my favourite school subject.
senses.note: A subject of study, one of several materie.

senses.ex: Gli atomi costituiscono la materia.
senses.exEn: Atoms make up matter.
senses.note: Physical substance, usually singular in this general meaning. Distinct materials can instead be called materie.

senses.ex: La batteria del telefono è scarica.
senses.exEn: The phone battery is flat.
senses.note: A device that supplies electrical energy.

senses.ex: Nel gruppo suono la batteria.
senses.exEn: I play drums in the band.
senses.note: La batteria names a drum kit; le batterie can refer to several kits.

senses.ex: Il cartello indica la strada per la stazione.
senses.exEn: The sign shows the way to the station.
senses.note: A public written sign, notice or placard.

senses.ex: Le imprese hanno formato un cartello sui prezzi.
senses.exEn: The companies formed a price cartel.
senses.note: An agreement between businesses to limit competition.

senses.ex: A Bologna prendo la coincidenza per Verona.
senses.exEn: In Bologna I catch my connection to Verona.
senses.note: A connection allowing travellers to change trains or other transport.

senses.ex: Che coincidenza: abitiamo nella stessa via!
senses.exEn: What a coincidence: we live on the same street!
senses.note: Events or circumstances happen to coincide.

senses.ex: I media hanno parlato della notizia.
senses.exEn: The media reported the news.
senses.note: Plural masculine: i media. It has no ordinary singular lesson in this use. It is not la media, an average.

senses.ex: La media dei voti è otto.
senses.exEn: The average grade is eight.
senses.note: Singular feminine la media; plural le medie. Le medie can also mean middle school, which is a separate construction.

senses.ex: Il laboratorio analizza un campione d’acqua.
senses.exEn: The laboratory analyses a water sample.
senses.note: A sample of material. A statistical campione is a selected group, a related use not a sporting champion.

senses.ex: Luca è campione italiano di nuoto.
senses.exEn: Luca is the Italian swimming champion.
senses.note: The feminine is campionessa, plural campionesse. This lesson models il campione; it is not a laboratory sample.

senses.ex: Ho fatto un prelievo al bancomat.
senses.exEn: I made a cash withdrawal at the ATM.
senses.note: Money taken from an account.

senses.ex: Il medico ha richiesto un prelievo di sangue.
senses.exEn: The doctor requested a blood draw.
senses.note: The action of taking material for examination, not the blood itself. No preparation advice is given.

senses.ex: Queste scarpe sono in promozione.
senses.exEn: These shoes are on special offer.
senses.note: A commercial offer intended to encourage sales.

senses.ex: Ha ricevuto una promozione a direttrice.
senses.exEn: She received a promotion to director.
senses.note: Advancement to a higher position; school and sporting advancement are related uses.

senses.ex: C’è una perdita d’acqua sotto il lavandino.
senses.exEn: There is a water leak under the sink.
senses.note: Liquid or gas escapes from a container or pipe.

senses.ex: La vendita ha causato una perdita di denaro.
senses.exEn: The sale caused a financial loss.
senses.note: Losing money or another thing; this lesson models a financial loss.

senses.ex: Il conduttore presenta gli ospiti della trasmissione.
senses.exEn: The presenter introduces the programme’s guests.
senses.note: Feminine conduttrice, plural conduttrici; this lesson models il conduttore.

senses.ex: Il contratto indica il nome del conduttore.
senses.exEn: The contract gives the tenant’s name.
senses.note: Formal tenancy language; feminine conduttrice. No particular legal obligation is asserted.

senses.ex: Il rame è un buon conduttore di elettricità.
senses.exEn: Copper is a good conductor of electricity.
senses.note: A material or component that conducts energy, not a person presenting a programme.
